cases.question: Why do customers keep being asked to authenticate again when their session runs out?

citations.quote: Rotate auth refresh tokens when a login session is renewed.

result.answer: Customers report a login loop after their session expires, where the system repeatedly redirects them to the login page even when the session has already expired. This issue is caused by the system attempting to refresh the auth refresh token, which leads to a loop in the authentication process. The release note indicates that the refresh token rotation mechanism was introduced in version 2.8.0, which may contribute to this behavior.
